The Network Info Panel renders your network history as smooth curves on a wall-sized multi-block screen.

It does not just record §6EU wireless network status§r — connected to an ME network, it also tracks §dreal-time and historical item changes§r inside it.

How it works: EU wireless readings follow the placing player's own wireless network; for the ME side, right-click the panel while holding an §eitem or fluid cell§r to configure what to monitor. You can also open its terminal for more detailed settings.

Its edge: §aextremely low performance and memory consumption§r while recording up to §aa full year§r of network history — §b8 nested time windows (5m/1h/8h/24h/7d/1M/3M/1Y)§r on a §e61-point FIFO§r, drawn as Fritsch-Carlson splines. All screens placed by the same player share one dataset.
